conventions.bracketed: Value in [brackets] in WAFCT: estimated, imputed, calculated or of lower quality; kept and flagged.
conventions.trace: "tr" in WAFCT: trace, below the limit of quantification; stored as 0 and flagged.

conventions.ediblePortionFactor: EDIBLE1: edible portion coefficient from as purchased to as described.
conventions.yieldFactor: Cooked weight / raw weight, from sheet "07 Yield factors, sing_ing", for single-ingredient cooked foods only.
conventions.retentionFactors: Sheet "08 Retention factors" (mainly Bognár 2002 / USDA 2007): fraction of a nutrient retained by a food type and cooking process.
